01 The Brief

Michael, you built this place in 2008 with a clear vision. The right buyer should feel that vision before they ever arrive.

You told me you want someone who can capture the essence and the vibe of what you created, and get it in front of the right people. That is exactly how I build every campaign. Here is what we are bringing to market:

02 The Location

A quiet beach, with Tamarindo close by.

Playa Junquillal is a long, open beach on the Pacific coast of Santa Cruz, with very little development and a slower pace than the towns to the north. Buyers get space, privacy and sunsets over an uncrowded beach, with restaurants, surf breaks and services a short drive away.

35minto Tamarindo
15minto Playa Avellanas
90minto Liberia International Airport (LIR)

Drive times are approximate and vary with road conditions.

Who we will be marketing to

Second-home buyers

Americans and Canadians who want a beach home in a calmer setting than the busier towns up the coast.

Surf and lifestyle buyers

People drawn to the breaks at Avellanas and Playa Negra who want to live close to the water.

Investors

Buyers looking for beach-area property they can use part of the year and rent the rest.

Builders and families

For the lot: buyers ready to design a home of their own on the beach.

06 The Plan · Three Residences

Everything a buyer needs to fall for it from far away.

Most of your buyers will see the property on a screen long before they visit. The campaign is built so that by the time they book a flight, they already know they want it.

01

Cinematic walkthrough

A long-form, conversational tour of each residence for YouTube and the property page, filmed room by room with real detail about how the space lives.

02

Social video series

Vertical Reels for Instagram, TikTok and Facebook, posted on @soldbytiago and shared across KRAIN's channels.

03

Drone and location films

Aerial footage that shows the gardens, the pool and palapa, the walk to the beach and the coastline around it, so buyers understand the setting in a few seconds.

04

Professional photography

Interiors, exteriors and shared spaces, shot in daylight and at twilight, ready for the MLS, the property page, print and ads.

05

Targeted paid ads

Meta and YouTube campaigns aimed at buyers in the U.S. and Canada who are actively looking at Costa Rica, with retargeting for anyone who engages with the videos.

06

Dedicated property page

One page for the project with every unit, the videos, the photos and a direct inquiry form. Every ad and every post points back to it.

07 The Plan · Beachfront Lot
TodayConcept rendering

Drag to compare

Concept rendering is an illustration of potential use only. Final design depends on zoning, maritime zone regulations and permits.

Selling what the lot can become.

Land is hard to sell from photos of grass and trees. Buyers need help picturing the finished home, so the campaign for the lot is built around showing them exactly that.

  • 01

    Drone mapping with boundaries

    Aerial footage with the lot lines drawn right on the shot, so buyers see the frontage, the size and the orientation at a glance.

  • 02

    AI concept renderings

    Concept homes placed onto our own drone stills of the actual lot, in a few styles, from a modern beach villa to a small boutique retreat.

  • 03

    Walk-the-lot video

    A golden hour walk from the road to the sand, showing what it feels like to stand on the property.

  • 04

    Ads for people ready to build

    Campaigns aimed at buyers searching for land in Costa Rica, plus direct outreach to builders and agents in the KRAIN network.

08 Selling Three Units

One project, several ways to buy into it.

Individual campaignsEach unit stands on its own

Every residence gets its own video, its own photos and its own price positioning, so buyers can compare and choose the one that fits.

Package optionFor investors who want more

We also present the three units together, and the lot if you'd like, to investors looking to buy several properties in one transaction.

One shared storyInterest that compounds

All of the content ties back to the property and to Junquillal, so a buyer who comes in for one unit learns about the others.
